headline: United States Proposes Stricter Rules on Tech Investments in China
summary: The U.S. government proposed tightened restrictions on outbound American investments into strategic Chinese technology sectors.
why: Targeted outbound investment screenings restrict venture capital and private equity allocations into sensitive Chinese semiconductor, AI, and quantum technologies.

impacts.name: Venture Capital & Private Equity
impacts.why: Outbound investment restrictions limit deal flow and cross-border tech fund returns in Asia.

impacts.name: Semiconductors & AI
impacts.why: Tighter U.S. controls curtail access to Western venture capital, expertise, and cross-border research.
